view_frame: Front view (XZ) shows the wheel face with radial symmetry. Right view (YZ) shows the wheel thickness. The wheel axis is aligned with the Y-axis. The wheel lies in the XZ plane.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Outer radius 60 mm, inner radius 50 mm. Extends from Y=-4 to Y=4.
features.evidence: Front view shows outer and inner concentric circles. Right view shows rectangular profile. Label 'OD 120 mm; thickness 8 mm'.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Radius 15 mm. Extends from Y=-4 to Y=4.
features.evidence: Front view shows central circle. Right view shows rectangular profile matching rim thickness.

features.placement: 8 spokes radiating from hub to rim. Each spoke is a box extending from radius 15 mm to 50 mm. Spokes are centered on angles 0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315 degrees in the XZ plane. Extends from Y=-4 to Y=4.
features.evidence: Front view shows 8 radial lines connecting hub to rim. Right view shows uniform thickness.

connections: All features share the same Y-axis thickness (8 mm)
edit_rules: Changing OD 120 mm updates rim outer radius and spoke outer endpoints
Changing thickness 8 mm updates Y-extent of all features
Changing spoke count updates number of radial boxes
Changing ASSUMED rim width updates rim inner radius and spoke inner endpoints
Changing ASSUMED hub diameter updates hub radius and spoke inner endpoints
Changing ASSUMED spoke width updates spoke box width
